audit.summary: Four confirmed Major defects: simultaneous ramified-stalk equivariance, full K3 irreducibility, principal-polarization realization, and the faithful tensor-power Artin step. Five bounded Minor corrections remain. Explicit repairs and exact-version/dependency limitations retained.
limitations: Ramified stalk cannot be simultaneously Galois- and H-stable — Counterevidence: A single branch is H-stable but notG_Q-stable; diagonal is G_Q-stable but notH-stable. Propositionconclusion itself is not refuted.
Full polarized K3 H2 is reducible — Counterevidence: Primitive local system is absolutely irreducible. Corollaryconclusion is not refuted and can be repaired by exterior powers.
Level-three basis does not yield principal polarization — Counterevidence: A isisogenous toprincipallypolarizedJ; rationalH1 unchanged. ExplicitZarhinexampleandownmod2/3calculationretained.
Nonnormal quotient is not a group scheme — Counterevidence: Restriction-surjectivityofLemma2.2andfinitecoverargumentsneednocosetgroup.
Cyclic proalgebraic completion has wrong descent and splitting — Counterevidence: AbstractsplittingoverQpbar existsbutdoesnotdescend. Laterfinite-translateproofdoesnotuseexample.
Roots-of-unity hypothesis does not imply criterion — Counterevidence: Infinitep-adiccyclotomicimage holds fornumberfields, so mainarithmeticsettingescapes.
Faithful representation need not generate regular in one power — Counterevidence: W⊕1allowsdegreepadding; permutationQ[S] hasfreeenumerationtupleorbitin|S|thpower.
Proposition7.1 arbitrary-field scope fails in characteristic p — Counterevidence: Finite-dimensionality/localfiniteness holdsintheactualnumberfielduses. Thisisnotmereinfinitedimensionargument.
Removing only one fibre does not give an open-subgroup injection — Counterevidence: Belyiapplicationsremoveallthreebranchvaluesandarefiniteétaleontheactualopens.
